collection.browser: Playwright Chromium, anonymous new contexts, ko-KR, 1440x1000
collection.method: domcontentloaded then 4.5 seconds; live DOM read without page modifications or sign-in
collection.candidatePolicy: v1 generic extraction: bounded document-order candidates, exact-value dedup; first 8 plus none; SHA256-based deterministic shuffle by case ID; no labels or model output consulted
collection.annotationMethod: Human/agent review of captured official public HTML, element ancestry, local text and rendered screenshots. No evaluated model output was used. Candidate pools were fixed generically before annotation.

excludedCaptureAttempts.reason: Initial intended detail redirected to login/age access page. Before model evaluation, replaced by a publicly readable movie in the same new franchise to meet the four-work-detail target.

modelIsolation: Model payload builders receive only input rows. Labels, annotation notes, work provenance and canonical title targets are separate and must not enter prompts. Template selection uses only development; new holdout labels remain unread by template author until selection is locked.
